priorityOrdering.title: Priority ordering
priorityOrdering.description: Your modules are listed first on collection and character pages.

themeColor.title: Theme color

searchAlerts.title: Search alerts
searchAlerts.description: Save any market search and get a message the moment a new module matches it, on a contract or as a direct listing.

show.pricingTitle: One subscription, two ways to pay
show.perCharacterNote: Premium is per character — the character that sends the ISK gets it.

send.title: Send the ISK in-game
send.description: Send the amount for your plan as an ISK donation to {name} — from the character that should get premium.

pickup.title: We pick it up automatically
pickup.description: The wallet is checked every minute. EVE's API can delay new donations, so allow up to an hour for yours to appear.

confirm.title: Confirmation by EVE mail
confirm.description: Once processed, your character receives an in-game mail from {name} and premium is active immediately.

show.partialNote: Sent a partial amount? Donations accumulate — top up the difference and premium activates as soon as a full month is covered.
show.closingTitle: Send the ISK, we handle the rest.

gift.title: Gift premium time
gift.description: Move whole days of a character's premium to any other character. They get an in-game mail right away.

adFree.title: Ad-free premium
adFree.description: Everything premium unlocks, and no ads anywhere on the site. It costs {factor}x premium: {monthly} ISK a month or {yearly} ISK a year.
adFree.switchNote: The time left converts at its ISK value: {plain} days of premium make {adFree} ad-free days, and the other way round. Once ad-free, the account can switch back after {days} days.
adFree.ticketNote: Put the sending character on ad-free below, so the ISK buys ad-free months. Switching later converts the time instead.
adFree.switchedPremium: Your account is back on premium.
adFree.confirmLock: You can switch back to premium on {date} at the earliest. Switching back turns the time left into premium again at the same rate.
adFree.confirmIntro: No ads anywhere on MutaMarket. Ad-free costs {factor}x premium, so the premium time you have left shrinks to a third, on every character.

account.title: Your premium
